_about: Motor data for every gearbox type, read by CommonComponents.load_motor(). Values and their sources are recorded in config_files/motors_draft.md.
_rating_help: peak: gears sized with peak_torque_Nm, stress check at no_load_speed_rpm. rated: rated_torque_Nm and rated_speed_rpm (datasheet for frameless motors, mostly estimates for framed motors - see each *_basis).

U8_Lite.source: T-Motor U8 Lite datasheet; mounting and wire slot measured by user 2026-10-16
U8_Lite.notes: Replaces the old code name U8. Rotor alt. 4 x M3 @ PCD 20.

electrical.rated_current_basis: estimate: T-Motor max continuous power 370 W / 48 V
electrical.rated_torque_basis: estimate: Kt (peak torque / peak current) x rated current
electrical.rated_speed_basis: estimate: KV x (48 V - rated current x 170 mOhm line-to-line); T-Motor 'Internal Resistance', taken as line-to-line

mechanical.rotor_inertia_source: rule calibrated on the measured T-Motor U8 KV100 (1.2e-4 kg m^2, 242 g, Lee, Pan, Rouse, IROS 2019); see motors_draft.md, Phase A
